summary: UnicodeDecodeError escapes the OSError-only fail-open in _check_body_shas/_dry_run_sha_note; one non-UTF-8 body crashes the whole driver run (plan §6 never-refuse violation). Widen the except tuple.
evidence: scripts/daily_drive_filings.py:302 and :334 — empirically reproduced: route-3 body with \x80 byte raises UnicodeDecodeError (not OSError); main() has no per-item catch, so the crash aborts all remaining filings with exit != 0. Fix: except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError) + a bad-encoding regression test through the main(argv) harness.
